python3 -c "
import statistics

# Annual convertible foreign currencies (CY 1963-1977) in millions of dollars
data = [212, 432, 781, 1321, 2345, 3528, 2781, 629, 276, 241, 8, 5, 80, 320, 18]

n = len(data)
mean = statistics.mean(data)
stdev = statistics.stdev(data)  # sample stdev (n-1)

print(f'n = {n}')
print(f'mean = {mean}')
print(f'sample stdev = {stdev}')

# Fisher-Pearson adjusted skewness (sample skewness, bias-corrected)
# Formula: (n / ((n-1)*(n-2))) * sum(((x - mean) / stdev)**3)
skew = (n / ((n-1)*(n-2))) * sum(((x - mean) / stdev)**3 for x in data)

print(f'skewness = {skew}')
print(f'rounded to 3 decimals = {round(skew, 3)}')
"
